job: 1675 Summit Point Ct — Deck with Porch Cover
notes: Built to the homeowner's TOP DOWN PLAN as drawn (the design intent), with the 6' wing wall per the owner's annotation. Facing the house from the yard, left to right: the wing, 6' at its top wall and 30' deep with its outer edge open (rail); the angled bay in the house cuts into the wing's inner edge (two 10'5" angled walls, 2'-7" deep — the rim and the boards are mitred along them, framed as the full 6' rectangle in the count); the short wall; the brick chimney bay (10'6" wide, the chimney 3' proud, so 7'-6" deep); the porch bay 16' wide x 10'-6" deep. PORCH COVER: a 26'-6" x 10'-6" shed roof over the chimney bay and the porch bay — ledger on the house, rafters down to a beam on four 6x6 cedar posts at the rail line (per the plan's photo) — DRAWN, NOT PRICED: the roof needs a roof rate (framing, sheathing, roofing, ceiling); the deck frame is engineered to carry it. Heights per the plan: 8' at the left, 6' at the right; frame at 8', posts cut to grade; the 4' stair leaves the right end next to the house, 9 risers (66") to a concrete pad, one rail. Existing deck demo'd. Cinch Satin Black with the deck-board drink rail (the plan's 'black metal balusters with wood top rail'). The plan's 37' overall is held: 6 + 4.5 + 10.5 + 16. The '9'' and '10'5"' labels on the plan do not fit inside 37' and were scaled to the drawing. PPRBD: 30 psf snow, 30" frost, 115 mph — confirm the lot is not in the special wind region. FINISHES (owner 16 Sep): deck skirt HardieTrim 4/4 x 12 ColorPlus Timber Bark around the rim in place of composite fascia; cover ceiling HardieSoffit 4x10 cedarmill Timber Bark; cover fascia and rakes HardieTrim 4/4 x 7-1/4 rustic Timber Bark over 2x8 sub-fascia. Hardie prices are estimates until D&D quotes them. OWNER 16 Sep: TimberTech Advanced PVC Vintage Weathered Teak, square shoulder, every board Cortex-screwed through the face (Class A / WUI); 2x10 joists at 12" OC; HardieTrim 4/4 x 12 Timber Bark skirt. OWNER 22 Oct: all decking TimberTech Vintage English Walnut (field, picture frame, drink-rail board). OWNER 22 Oct: MIRRORED to match the site (City GIS aerial): facing the house from the yard the 30' wing runs up the RIGHT (east) side of the house; the porch bay, chimney bay and the stair are on the left (west) of the main deck. All geometry flipped x' = 37' - x. OWNER 22 Oct: footings are Diamond Piers.
